title: Chimichurri
summary: Parsley, raw garlic, red wine vinegar, and olive oil. Sharp and fresh against grilled steak.

steps.title: Tame the garlic
steps.text: Stir the garlic, vinegar, oregano, chili flakes, and salt together and let it sit. The vinegar takes the harsh edge off the raw garlic.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the parsley and olive oil. Chop the parsley by hand; a food processor bruises it into a paste.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Let it sit while the steak cooks. It gets better for the first hour.

notes: Homemade beats jarred here: the parsley, raw garlic, and vinegar are the whole point and all fade in a jar. To rescue a jarred one, stir in a fresh garlic clove, a splash of red wine vinegar, and chopped parsley.
